models.name: shopping_mall_system_configs
models.description:
System configuration parameters for the e-commerce platform. Stores application-wide settings such as max cart items, payment thresholds, and system behavior rules.

Configuration keys follow a consistent naming pattern (e.g., max_cart_items, min_order_value) to ensure logical grouping. Each configuration has a human-readable description for management clarity.

The configuration system supports both string values (for simple settings) and JSON strings (for complex structured data). This allows flexibility while maintaining database integrity through unique configuration keys.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration identifier (e.g., max_cart_items, payment_min_amount).

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value as string (can contain JSON for complex structures).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration purpose and acceptable values.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft deleted (if applicable).

models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description:
System channels for payment, shipping, and other integration services. Defines available channels and their operational status for the e-commerce platform.

Channel types include payment gateways, shipping carriers, email services, and notification channels. Each channel entry contains a name, type, status, and optional configuration parameters.

The channel management system powers the entire payment and shipping flow, ensuring users see only supported options and administrators can easily enable/disable integrations.

plainFields.name: channel_name
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the channel (e.g., stripe, fedex, gmail).

plainFields.name: channel_type
plainFields.description: Type of channel (e.g., payment, shipping, email, notification).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status (active, inactive, maintenance).

plainFields.name: config
plainFields.description: JSON string containing channel-specific configuration parameters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was soft deleted (if applicable).

models.name: shopping_mall_features
models.description:
Features enabled or disabled for the platform, such as wishlist functionality, product reviews, and inventory tracking. Defines which platform functionality is available to users.

Each feature has a name that follows a consistent pattern to enable easy identification. Features are controlled via the enabled flag and can be toggled on/off through the admin interface without code changes.

The feature system allows for gradual rollouts and A/B testing of new platform capabilities while maintaining a clean separation between core platform functionality and optional features.

plainFields.name: feature_name
plainFields.description: Name of the feature (e.g., wishlist, product_reviews, inventory_tracking).

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the feature is currently enabled for the platform (true or false).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the feature's purpose and business value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the feature was soft deleted (if applicable).

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Customer account records for user authentication and profile management.

Stores registration details for authenticated platform users with business email verification requirements. Each customer account requires a unique email and secure password hash for login functionality, with timestamps tracking account activity.

The system enforces email confirmation before account activation, ensuring valid contact information for communication and security purposes. Customer accounts are independent entities requiring full CRUD operations through user interfaces, including password management and profile updates.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's verified business email address used for login and communication. Must be unique and match business domain format, not personal email services.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed user password using bcrypt with 12 rounds, stored for authentication. Never stored as plain text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp indicating when the customer account was registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp tracking changes to customer profile details.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Deletion timestamp for soft deletes, enabling audit trails while maintaining content history.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Seller business account records for platform management and marketplace access.

Stores verified business information for merchants using the e-commerce platform. Seller accounts require business license verification and include authentication credentials for secure access to seller dashboard features.

The system maintains separate business verification workflows to ensure seller compliance with platform policies. Seller accounts function as primary entities requiring independent registration, profile management, and authentication operations.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's business email address for platform communication and verification. Must match business domain format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed seller password using bcrypt with 12 rounds, stored for authentication security.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Official business name registered with platform verification system.

plainFields.name: tax_id
plainFields.description: Business tax ID or registration number required for verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Seller account creation timestamp showing when business was registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp tracking updates to seller business information.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Deletion timestamp for soft deletion of seller accounts during verification process.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Platform administrator account management enabling system oversight and configuration.

Administrative accounts provide privileged access to platform controls, analytics, and user management. Each administrator must authenticate with secure credentials to access sensitive administrative functions.

The system enforces strict access control policies and audit trails for all administrative actions. Admin accounts serve as primary entities requiring independent management through dedicated administrative interfaces.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's business email address for authentication and system notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed administrator password for system access control.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp for administrative account.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for administrative account settings.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Deletion timestamp for administrative account soft deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated customer accounts with connection context tracking.

Maintains session details for customer login sessions including IP address, connection URL, and referrer information for security and auditing. Each session has a creation timestamp with optional expiration for access management.

Sessions are managed exclusively through the parent customer account with no independent API endpoints required. The subsidiary stance classification ensures session management follows related entity operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who created this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address recorded during session initiation for security monitoring.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL that initiated the session for tracking user journey.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous page URL that led to session initiation for analytics context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp indicating when the login occurred.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic access termination.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated seller accounts with business context tracking.

Tracks administrative sessions for seller business management including IP address, connection URL, and referrer information. Seller sessions maintain access duration with creation and optional expiration timestamps.

Session details are exclusively managed through the seller account, following subsidiary stance for operational consistency. The system ensures seller sessions adhere to platform security protocols without independent management requirements.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created this session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Seller's IP address for session security monitoring and authentication audit.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Business dashboard URL that initiated the session for access context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous business page that led to seller session initiation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Seller session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp if manually set by seller.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Administrative session records for platform oversight and system management.

Maintains access details for admin logins including security context (IP, URL, referrer) for audit trail purposes. Administrative sessions have creation timestamp with optional expiration for security protocols.

Session management strictly follows subsidiary stance, requiring operation through admin account context. The system ensures all admin activities are linked to specific authenticated sessions for accountability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who created this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Administrator IP address recorded for security audits and access tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: System management URL that triggered session initiation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous administrative page that led to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Administrator session creation timestamp showing login time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Administrative session expiration timestamp if set.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product listings managed by sellers. Each product represents a primary entity with unique characteristics, variants, and pricing.

Contains product title, description, base price, category associations, and lifecycle management attributes. These products are visible in the main catalog for customer browsing and purchasing.

Each product can have multiple variants (SKUs) for different colors, sizes, or options, all tracked separately for inventory purposes. The system automatically displays available variants based on stock levels.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed to customers. Must be descriptive and unique per catalog.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the product, including key features, materials, and usage instructions.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product in USD, excluding tax, for the main product listing.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Reference to the main product category. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the product was first created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the product was last updated, including variant changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the product was deleted (soft delete). Null indicates active product.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variants (SKUs) representing different color, size, or option combinations. Each variant is a distinct entity with independent inventory and pricing.

Manages inventory for specific product configurations, with each variant having its own unique SKU, price, and availability status. The product variants directly determine what options are available for customers to purchase.

Each variant is connected to the main product through a foreign key relationship, allowing for accurate inventory tracking at the SKU level and efficient order fulfillment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main product. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique stock keeping unit (SKU) identifier for the variant. Generated per product with color/size combination.

plainFields.name: color
plainFields.description: Color option for the product variant. Null indicates no color distinction.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: Size option for the product variant. Null indicates no size distinction.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price of the specific variant, which may differ from the base product price.

plainFields.name: inventory
plainFields.description: Current inventory count for this specific variant (SKU). Tracks real-time availability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when this product variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when this product variant's inventory or details were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when this variant was soft-deleted. Null indicates active inventory status.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Product category structure used for organizing products in the catalog. Each category represents an organizational unit for products.

Contains hierarchical category mappings where categories can have parent-child relationships for nested categorization. This structure enables comprehensive product organization without needing to recreate category information for each product.

Each category appears in the catalog navigation and is used as filters for product searches by customers. The system ensures that categories remain consistent across the entire product library.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent category for hierarchical organization. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name displayed in product catalog navigation. Must be descriptive and distinct.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for the category used in navigation paths. Must be unique across all categories.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the category was first created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the category was last updated, including name or structure changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the category was soft-deleted. Null indicates active category.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews
models.description:
Customer feedback on product listings, including numerical ratings and written comments. Each review represents a verified customer experience with a purchased item.

Contains both a star rating (1-5) and optional text comments from customers who have purchased the product. Reviews are moderated for compliance before being displayed on product pages.

The review system enables customers to make informed purchasing decisions based on real user experiences, and provides sellers with valuable feedback on their product quality and descriptions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numeric rating given by the customer, between 1 and 5 stars.

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Optional written feedback from the customer about their experience with the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the review was submitted by the customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the review was last modified (e.g., updated comment).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the review was soft-deleted (usually for violation). Null indicates active review.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_ratings
models.description:
Store individual ratings for products as separate records. This table contains numerical ratings (1-5) provided by customers for specific products.

Each rating is associated with a product and a customer who submitted it. While reviews include comments, ratings focus solely on the numerical score without additional textual feedback.

This table supports analytics and aggregation of rating data, allowing the system to calculate average ratings across all customer submissions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product being rated. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who provided the rating. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numeric rating given to the product, between 1 and 5 stars.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the rating was submitted by the customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the rating was last modified (if applicable).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the rating was soft-deleted. Null indicates active rating.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory
models.description:
SKU-level inventory tracking for products with real-time stock management.

Manages current inventory quantities for each product variant, enabling real-time stock updates to prevent overselling and maintain accurate product availability. Each record represents a specific product variant's current stock level, tracking changes as orders are placed or inventory is adjusted.

The inventory system is the authoritative source for available stock levels, with all order processing operations directly querying this table to confirm availability. When stock decreases due to orders or adjustments, this table is immediately updated to reflect the new real-time quantity.

The table follows a strict relationship pattern with product variants, where each product variant has exactly one inventory record, ensuring proper normalization while maintaining efficient querying patterns for inventory-level operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant in the catalog. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity for this product variant. Must be non-negative integer.

plainFields.name: last_updated
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last inventory update. Used for tracking freshness of stock data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory record was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_alerts
models.description:
Inventory notification system tracking low-stock and stock adjustment alerts.

Records all inventory-related alerts generated for sellers, including low-stock notifications and out-of-stock triggers. Each alert represents a specific inventory event (e.g., stock drop below threshold, stock replenishment) that requires seller attention through the inventory management system.

The system maintains a historical record of all alerts, allowing sellers to review past stock concerns and adjust their inventory management strategies accordingly. Alerts are triggered automatically when inventory levels reach configured thresholds, providing the seller with actionable insights about their product availability.

All alerts reference the inventory record that triggered them, ensuring traceability between alert events and specific inventory states, while maintaining clear separation between alert data and core inventory tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the inventory record that generated this alert. {@link shopping_mall_inventory.id}

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: Type of inventory alert (e.g., 'LOW_STOCK', 'OUT_OF_STOCK', 'REPLENISH').

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Human-readable alert message explaining the specific inventory situation.

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was generated and sent to the seller.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert record was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
User shopping cart for active items to purchase.

Manages temporary collections of product items for the current shopping session. Carts store references to product variants with quantities and are associated with specific customer accounts. Carts allow for saving progress between sessions and can be merged when users log in. Each cart is owned by exactly one customer and remains active until explicitly emptied or converted to an order.

Carts can be in various states (active, abandoned), though state tracking is handled through separate order management system. This table represents the persistent cart entity with standard audit fields and customer ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Cart last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Nullable for soft delete capability.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Line items within a shopping cart.

Represents each product variant added to a cart, with quantity and specific options. Each cart item associates a product variant to a cart and tracks the selected options. Cart items are managed independently (e.g., users can remove specific items without removing the cart). This table includes references to product variants (SKU), cart, and current pricing information.

Cart items are deleted when the user removes items from the cart, not when the cart is deleted to maintain historical data. Each item has its own lifecycle but is tightly coupled with the owning cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Cart's {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of items added to cart.

plainFields.name: price_at_addition
plainFields.description: Product price at the time of adding to cart, for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Line item creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Line item last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Nullable for soft delete capability.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Items saved in user's wishlist for future purchase.

Represents products users have marked to view and potentially purchase at a later time. Wishlist items store references to product variants without quantities, as they are not yet ready for purchase. Each wishlist item is associated with a specific customer and product variant.

Wishlist items are managed separately from carts to support the 'save for later' workflow. They don't have the same lifecycle as cart items - users can save items without creating a cart, and items can be kept indefinitely. Wishlist items are deleted when the user removes them.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist item creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist item last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Nullable for soft delete capability.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order entity capturing the current state of a customer's purchase request.

Represents the entire order lifecycle including payment status, shipping information, and customer relationship. Each order corresponds to a single customer and payment method. The system tracks both the current order status and historical changes through separate order history entries.

Orders can be modified until processed, after which status transitions to 'processing' and modifications are restricted. This table serves as the central point for order management workflows and customer support inquiries related to order status.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'). Status transitions follow business workflow rules.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total order value including items, shipping, and tax. Calculated as sum of order items plus shipping cost and tax.

plainFields.name: shipping_address
plainFields.description: Full shipping address for delivery. Includes street, city, postal code, and country information.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order creation timestamp, set automatically during order placement. Tracks when the order was initially created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for order modifications. Tracks when order details were last changed by user or system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Set automatically when order is deleted, allowing audit trails and recovery options.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Detailed line items for orders with item-specific quantities and pricing.

Each order contains multiple items representing specific product variants. This table stores the exact quantities, prices, and variant information for each order line. The data structure supports complex product configurations like size and color variations without duplicating product catalog data.

Order items require independent management as users need to view specific items within an order, request item-level returns, and see item-specific pricing details. Each item is tied to a single product variant with inventory tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product variant included in this order line. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased for this specific product variant in the order.

plainFields.name: price_at_purchase
plainFields.description: Price of the product variant at the time of purchase. Tracks historical pricing for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Item creation timestamp, set automatically during order placement. Tracks when this order item was added to the order.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for item modifications. Tracks when the order item details were last changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Set automatically when an item is removed from the order, allowing audit trails and recovery options.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_history
models.description:
Historical snapshots of order state transitions for audit and analytics.

Captures point-in-time versions of orders for change tracking and historical analysis. Each change to the main order (status, shipping info, etc.) creates a new history entry with all current order fields. This pattern enables tracking of order progress without impacting current order data.

The table follows a strict append-only pattern - historical states are never modified or deleted directly by users. All history entries are read-only and can only be created through system-triggered state transitions. This architecture supports comprehensive audit trails and historical reporting on order progress patterns.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this history entry belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: order_id
plainFields.description: Reference to the order this snapshot represents. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the order at the time this history snapshot was created. Values match current order statuses.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount at the time of this snapshot. Tracks historical value including tax and shipping.

plainFields.name: shipping_address
plainFields.description: Shipping address version at time of snapshot. May differ from current shipping address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history snapshot was created. Matches the order state change time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for this history record itself, not the order state. Always equals created_at for snapshot entries.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description:
Core payment processing records for all successful transactions.

Stores comprehensive payment details for every order, including transaction identifiers, monetary values, and payment method. This table serves as the central point for financial verification and reconciliation across the platform. Payment state transitions are tracked through dedicated status fields and timestamps, enabling detailed audit trails for all completed transactions.

All payment records maintain explicit relationships to the corresponding orders and customers, ensuring traceability from the point of sale through to final payment confirmation. The table supports multiple payment channels through the channel_id reference, allowing consistent payment processing across different payment systems.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Associated order within the system. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who completed the payment. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Payment provider channel used for the transaction. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Monetary value of the payment in specified currency. Reflects the total transaction amount before any discounts or adjustments.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for the payment (e.g., USD, EUR). Must follow ISO 4217 standard format to ensure international payment processing compatibility.

plainFields.name: payment_method
plainFields.description: Identification of the payment method used (e.g., 'credit_card', 'paypal', 'bank_transfer'). This field identifies the payment channel's payment processing method.

plainFields.name: transaction_id
plainFields.description: Unique transaction reference from the payment processor. Used for reconciliation with external payment providers.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current payment status. Valid values: pending, processing, completed, failed, refund_requested. Status transitions follow the platform's payment workflow rules.

plainFields.name: payment_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when payment was initiated. This timestamp is critical for financial reporting and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: payment_reference
plainFields.description: System-provided payment reference for internal tracking. Format: PAY-YYYYMMDD-NNNN

models.name: shopping_mall_refunds
models.description:
Financial refund processing records for completed transactions.

Tracks all refund requests and their associated status transitions, providing a complete audit trail of refund activities across the platform. Each refund record maintains a direct relationship to the original payment and the corresponding order, enabling comprehensive financial reconciliation. The table is designed to support multiple refund statuses and detailed reasons for refunds, aligning with both business needs and financial compliance.

Refund processing includes detailed tracking of status changes, refund amounts, and associated reasons, allowing for efficient customer support and financial reporting. The table supports full traceability from original payment to final refund, maintaining the integrity of the financial audit trail.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Original payment being refunded. {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Amount being refunded. Must not exceed the original payment amount to ensure financial accuracy.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided for the refund request (e.g., 'product_not_received', 'item_damaged', 'customer_change_mind'). Used for analytics and customer service improvements.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current refund status. Valid values: requested, processing, completed, declined. Status transitions follow the platform's refund workflow rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund status was last updated.

plainFields.name: refunded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund was processed and money returned to the customer. This field remains null until the refund is completed.
